headline: Jerome Powell: Failing to restore *price stability* is not an option
quote: the worst mistake we could make would be to fail
title: Powell, Jun 2022: Failing to lower inflation is not an option
caption: During the June 2022 FOMC press conference, Jerome Powell declared price stability to be the bedrock of the economy. He warned that failing to restore lower inflation would erode wages and hurt workers.
comment: Is restoring price stability worth the risk of slowing economic growth?
